summary: Complete initial independent audit of all 99 Chinese units, 52 temporal or active-hint checks, and ten extracted people. All explicitly numbered Tongzhi and Guangxu dates, their Western-year conversions, and their named event owners were checked against the chapter. Two linked Hart records incorrectly render the memorial's 上年六月至十二月 as AD 1895: the memorial itself is Guangxu 21 (1895), so its preceding June-to-December drafting interval is Guangxu 20 (1894). No source or canonical extraction was edited.
